name: comp-281
title: Dismissible Success Toast
description: Toast-style success message with a close button. Meant for temporary positive feedback displayed in toast queues.
use_when: Confirming successful actions via toast notifications. Best for transient feedback that doesn't need to persist.
avoid_when: Important success states requiring persistent display. When user needs explicit confirmation.
a11y: Close button lacks ARIA label. Parent toast container should provide role='status' or 'alert' and aria-live='polite'.
